rule: This file is the single source of truth for constants and names. To change a value or a name, change it here first; canon_check.py then lists every file that must follow. A push is blocked while a LIVE file disagrees.

dG_ATP.source: cellular ATP hydrolysis free energy used by the author (54 kJ/mol)

M_cell.source: author's settled ruling 2026-09-19/27: no ln2 in the definition

M_cell_Landauer.units: Landauer units (k_B T ln2 per bit)
M_cell_Landauer.source: conversion only; not a second definition

E_hold_meth.derivation: ln((1-eps)/eps) of the measured copy error on single molecules (Loyfer read-level, uncorrected)
E_hold_meth.range_note: 3.41-3.77 kT across datasets (ENCODE, instrument-corrected, upper end)

phi.units: fraction of one ATP per held bit

eps0_meth.units: error per methylated site per copy

H_min_450K_neutrophil.derivation: Met-A floor from purified 450K neutrophils (GSE88824, 8 donors, our Stage 1)

IAM's law.definition: Every irreversible transition from quantum potential to classical actuality pays k_B T ln 2 per bit to the nearest encoding surface at the local temperature.

Mahaffey number (M).definition: Drive energy over the thermal noise quantum: M = E_drive/(k_B T). Cell: 20.94 (30.2 in Landauer units).

Landauer metrology.definition: Measuring how far above its thermal floor an information-writing process operates, against a fixed physical zero, in any substrate.

MethylPhys CPG.definition: The instrument: Methylation Physics, Cellular Performance Gauge.

Met-A (Metrology A).definition: Program reading: Shannon entropy of the mean beta at a cell's identity loci over that cell type's reference floor, built from purified cells on the same platform, tared against same-run controls. Information theory only; no Landauer or energy content.

IAM-A.definition: Error reading: the per-molecule copy error of a cell's held methylation pattern, on single-molecule sequencing, read against the physics floor eps0 = 1/(1+exp(phi*M)). Thermodynamic; the cell's instance of IAM's law.

Salmon-A.definition: Not a separate quantity: IAM-A applied to salmonids (body temperature = water temperature).

M\\s*=\\s*30\\.2.replaced_by: M = 20.94 (30.2 only as the Landauer-unit conversion)

scope.record_files_note: Published editions, provenance scripts and verbatim records: kept as written, never edited to current language.
